senses.en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part
currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

ex.en: My grandfather stays active by swimming every morning.
ex.zh: 我祖父每天早晨游泳，保持活力。

ex.en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。

col: an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式
play an active role｜发挥积极作用
tip: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

senses.en: The sport of going up rocks, mountains, or artificial walls.
Growing upwards by attaching to or winding around supports.

ex.en: I tried indoor climbing with my sister yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我和姐姐尝试了室内攀岩。

ex.en: Schools can use supervised climbing activities to develop students' confidence, physical coordination, and ability to assess risks.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过有人指导的攀岩活动，培养学生的自信、身体协调性和风险评估能力。

tip: climb中的b不发音；climbing plants指攀缘植物。

senses.en: A journey visiting several places, or a guided visit somewhere.
A series of performances or matches held in different places.
To travel around places for sightseeing, performances, or other activities.

ex.en: We took a guided tour of the old castle.
ex.zh: 我们在导游带领下参观了那座古堡。

ex.en: Organized tours can introduce visitors to local traditions while providing reliable income for community guides.
ex.zh: 有组织的游览既能让游客了解当地传统，也能为社区导游提供稳定收入。

col: guided tour｜有导游带领的游览
go on tour｜进行巡回活动
tip: tour强调参观或多站行程；trip泛指一次出行。

senses.en: A set of rooms forming one home within a building.

ex.en: Our apartment has a small balcony overlooking the park.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓有一个面向公园的小阳台。

ex.en: Building affordable apartments near railway stations can reduce commuting costs for young workers.
ex.zh: 在火车站附近建设价格可负担的公寓，可以降低年轻上班族的通勤成本。

tip: 美式常用apartment，英式日常多用flat。

senses.en: surrounded by people or things
within or shared by a group

ex.en: We found a small wooden house among the trees.
ex.zh: 我们在树林中发现了一座小木屋。

ex.en: Regular exercise is increasingly popular among office workers who spend most of their day sitting.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼在一天大部分时间坐着的上班族中越来越受欢迎。

col: among other things｜除了别的以外还
tip: among强调群体内部；between也可用于多者的明确关系。

senses.en: Sliced bread browned and made crisp by heat.
To heat food until it becomes brown and crisp.
An occasion when people raise drinks to honour someone or something.

ex.en: I spread butter on my toast while it was warm.
ex.zh: 我趁烤面包片还热着，在上面抹了黄油。

ex.en: A simple breakfast of toast and fruit can help students maintain their energy during morning lessons.
ex.zh: 一顿由烤面包片和水果组成的简单早餐，有助于学生在上午上课时保持精力。

col: a slice of toast｜一片烤面包
a toast to someone｜为某人祝酒
tip: 表示烤面包时不可数；表示一次祝酒时可数。

senses.en: A comfortable seat for two or more people.
To express something in a particular way.

ex.en: We curled up on the couch after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。

ex.en: Public health advice should be couched in clear language so that everyone can understand it.
ex.zh: 公共卫生建议应以清晰的语言表述，让每个人都能理解。

col: couched in diplomatic terms｜以委婉措辞表达
tip: 动词常用be couched in，指以某种措辞表达。

senses.en: an area of land used for crops or farm animals
a particular area of study or work
an area of ground used for playing a sport

ex.en: We watched sheep grazing in the field behind our cottage.
ex.zh: 我们看着羊群在小屋后面的牧场上吃草。

ex.en: Research in the field of renewable energy could create employment opportunities and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 可再生能源领域的研究可以创造就业机会，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。

tip: 表示研究或工作领域时，常用in the field of。

senses.en: Available through the internet or connected to a computer network.
Using the internet or while connected to a computer network.

ex.en: I booked our train tickets online after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我在网上订了我们的火车票。

ex.en: Online courses can widen access to education, especially for learners who live far from universities.
ex.zh: 网络课程可以扩大受教育的机会，尤其有利于远离大学的学习者。

tip: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：shop online。

senses.en: A comfortable chair with supports for your arms.
Giving opinions without direct experience or active involvement.

ex.en: Grandpa fell asleep in his armchair beside the window.
ex.zh: 爷爷在窗边的扶手椅上睡着了。

ex.en: Armchair critics may underestimate the practical challenges that teachers face when managing large classes with limited resources.
ex.zh: 缺乏实践经验的评论者可能低估教师在资源有限时管理大班所面临的实际困难。

col: sit in an armchair｜坐在扶手椅里
tip: 坐在扶手椅里用in；作形容词时置于名词前，常含贬义。

senses.en: someone who plays music, especially professionally

ex.en: A musician played the violin outside the station.
ex.zh: 一位乐手在车站外拉小提琴。

ex.en: Local musicians can strengthen community identity by performing traditional songs at public festivals and cultural events.
ex.zh: 当地音乐人可以在公共节庆和文化活动中演奏传统歌曲，增强社区认同感。

tip: musician指音乐人；作曲家更具体地用composer。

senses.en: from a past time until a later time, usually now
from when something happened; because something is true
at a time or throughout the period after that

ex.en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
ex.zh: 我从小就住在这个街区。

ex.en: Since public transport reduces traffic congestion, governments should invest in more reliable bus services.
ex.zh: 由于公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，政府应投资建设更可靠的公交服务。

tip: 表时间时，since接起点，for接时长。

senses.en: a building where Christians gather to worship
Christian religious worship attended as a service
an organized group of Christians sharing beliefs and practices

ex.en: The old church has beautiful windows and a stone tower.
ex.zh: 这座古老的教堂有漂亮的窗户和一座石塔。

ex.en: Preserving a historic church can protect local heritage while providing opportunities for education and tourism.
ex.zh: 保护历史悠久的教堂既能保护当地文化遗产，也能为教育和旅游创造机会。

tip: go to church指做礼拜；go to the church指去教堂。

senses.en: A person trained to put out fires and rescue people

ex.en: The firefighter showed us how to use the hose.
ex.zh: 那位消防员向我们演示了如何使用消防水带。

ex.en: Every firefighter requires regular training to respond safely and effectively to emergencies in increasingly complex urban environments.
ex.zh: 每位消防员都需要定期接受培训，以便在日益复杂的城市环境中安全、有效地应对紧急情况。

col: a trained firefighter｜训练有素的消防员
tip: firefighter不区分性别，比fireman更通用。

senses.en: A grand official home for a royal or important leader.

ex.en: We walked through the palace gardens before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前，我们在王宫花园里散了步。

ex.en: Opening a historic palace to visitors can generate income for conservation and support local tourism.
ex.zh: 向游客开放历史悠久的宫殿，可以筹集保护资金并支持当地旅游业。

tip: 主要用作名词；palace gardens中作名词定语。

senses.en: A structure carrying people or vehicles over an obstacle.
To connect separated things or reduce differences between them.
A card game played by four people in two partnerships.

ex.en: We crossed the wooden bridge and entered the village.
ex.zh: 我们走过木桥，进了村子。

ex.en: Community language programmes can bridge cultural differences and help newcomers participate more fully in local life.
ex.zh: 社区语言项目可以弥合文化差异，帮助新来者更充分地参与当地生活。

tip: bridge the gap常指缩小群体或事物间的差距。

senses.en: happening every day
every day
a newspaper published every day

ex.en: I read the daily news on my phone every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上在手机上读每日新闻。

ex.en: Regular daily exercise improves both physical health and mental well-being.
ex.zh: 规律的日常锻炼能改善身体健康和心理健康。

tip: daily 是形容词或副词，不要与 diary（日记）混淆。

senses.en: the activity of taking food into your body
taking food into your mouth and swallowing it

ex.en: Healthy eating starts with small changes to your meals.
ex.zh: 健康饮食始于对日常餐食的小调整。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthy eating by providing balanced lunches and teaching children how to prepare simple meals.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供营养均衡的午餐并教孩子制作简单餐食来鼓励健康饮食。

tip: eating可作动名词；eat out表示外出就餐。

senses.en: the child of your son or daughter

ex.en: My grandmother shows photos of every grandchild on her phone.
ex.zh: 我奶奶在手机上展示每个孙辈的照片。

ex.en: Many grandparents look after a grandchild while the parents are at work.
ex.zh: 许多祖父母在父母上班时照看孙辈。

col: look after a grandchild｜照看孙辈
tip: 复数 grandchildren 不规则变化；由 grand + child 合成。

senses.en: a useful piece of advice
the narrow or pointed end of something
extra money given to someone for providing a service

ex.en: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
ex.zh: 邻居分享了一个种番茄的实用窍门。

ex.en: Schools can offer practical tips on managing money to help young people develop responsible spending habits.
ex.zh: 学校可以提供实用的理财建议，帮助年轻人养成负责任的消费习惯。

col: the tip of the tongue｜舌尖
tip: tip作“建议”可数，advice不可数：a tip。

senses.en: Practical use of scientific knowledge, especially through tools and machines.

ex.en: New technology lets us control the lights from our phones.
ex.zh: 新技术让我们可以用手机控制灯光。

ex.en: Investment in clean technology can reduce industrial pollution while creating skilled jobs in emerging sectors.
ex.zh: 投资清洁技术可以减少工业污染，同时在新兴领域创造技术岗位。

tip: 泛指科技时不可数；多种具体技术可用technologies。

senses.en: A narrow track for people to walk along.
The route along which someone or something moves.
A way of achieving something or developing over time.

ex.en: We followed a narrow path down to the beach.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走向海滩。

ex.en: Access to affordable education can provide a path out of poverty for disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得负担得起的教育可以为弱势社区提供一条摆脱贫困的道路。

col: a path to success｜通往成功的道路
tip: 表示实现目标的途径，用a path to，to后接名词。

senses.en: A set of connected parts that work together.
An organised structure through which services or institutions operate.
An organised way of doing something.

ex.en: The heating system stopped working during a cold night.
ex.zh: 在一个寒冷的夜晚，供暖系统停止了运行。

ex.en: An effective education system should support students with different abilities and prepare them for future employment.
ex.zh: 有效的教育体系应支持能力各异的学生，并帮助他们为未来就业做好准备。

col: public transport system｜公共交通系统
tip: systematic指有条理的，systemic指全系统的。

senses.en: The direction between north and east, or an area's northeastern part.
Located in, facing, or coming from the northeast.
Towards or in the direction between north and east.

ex.en: The storm is moving northeast towards the coastal villages.
ex.zh: 暴风雨正向东北方向的沿海村庄移动。

ex.en: Investment in rail connections could improve access to employment for communities in the northeast of the country.
ex.zh: 投资铁路交通可以为该国东北部的社区居民提供更多就业便利。

tip: northeast of表示在……东北方；英式也写north-east。

senses.en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre.

ex.en: This little plant grew one centimetre in a week.
ex.zh: 这株小植物一周长高了一厘米。

ex.en: Even a small rise in sea level, measured in centimetres, can increase flooding risks in coastal communities.
ex.zh: 即使海平面仅上升几厘米，也可能增加沿海社区的洪水风险。

tip: 英式拼写centimetre，美式centimeter；缩写cm。

senses.en: the scientific study of living things
the natural processes and characteristics of a living thing

ex.en: We examined onion cells under microscopes in biology today.
ex.zh: 今天的生物课上，我们用显微镜观察了洋葱细胞。

ex.en: A basic understanding of biology helps people evaluate health information and make informed decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 掌握基础生物学知识有助于人们评估健康信息，并对生活方式作出明智决定。

tip: 学科名称，通常不可数；生物学家是biologist。

senses.en: Someone who creates pictures using paint.
Someone whose job is painting buildings or other surfaces.

ex.en: The painter mixed blue and green on her palette.
ex.zh: 画家在调色板上混合蓝色和绿色。

ex.en: Local painters can preserve cultural traditions while introducing younger audiences to new artistic styles.
ex.zh: 当地画家既能传承文化传统，也能让年轻观众接触新的艺术风格。

tip: 既可指艺术画家，也可指刷墙的油漆工。

senses.en: A thin rubber bag filled with air or gas.
A large gas-filled bag carrying people in a basket.

ex.en: A yellow balloon floated above the birthday cake.
ex.zh: 一只黄色气球飘在生日蛋糕上方。

ex.en: Releasing balloons outdoors can harm wildlife when the rubber fragments fall into rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 在户外放飞气球可能危害野生动物，因为橡胶碎片会落入河流和海洋。

tip: blow up a balloon指吹气球，不是炸毁气球。

senses.en: Achieving the result that was wanted or intended.
Having achieved wealth, respect, or a good position.

ex.en: Our first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
ex.zh: 我们第一次尝试烤面包，出乎意料地成功了。

ex.en: Successful recycling programmes depend on convenient collection facilities and clear guidance for households and businesses.
ex.zh: 成功的回收计划依赖便利的收集设施，以及面向家庭和企业的明确指引。

col: successful in doing something｜成功做成某事
tip: 常用be successful in doing；动词为succeed。

senses.en: Something discussed, studied, or taught.
Affected by something or dependent on a condition.
To make someone experience something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
ex.zh: 我小时候最喜欢的学科是科学。

ex.en: Schools should give creative subjects sufficient attention because they help students develop imagination and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 学校应给予创意类学科充分重视，因为这些学科有助于培养学生的想象力和解决问题的能力。

col: subject someone to stress｜使某人承受压力
tip: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

senses.en: very unreasonable, foolish, or strange
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something
extremely annoyed or upset

ex.en: It seems crazy to wear sandals in this snow.
ex.zh: 下着这样的雪还穿凉鞋，实在很不明智。

ex.en: Although some people consider car-free cities a crazy idea, such policies could significantly improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 尽管一些人认为无车城市是个荒唐的想法，这类政策却可能显著改善城市空气质量。

tip: 偏口语；crazy about表示着迷，不宜用来称呼精神疾病患者。

senses.en: Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship.
Two things or people, or a small number of them.
To join two things or consider them together.

ex.en: The couple next door invited us over for dinner.
ex.zh: 隔壁那对夫妇邀请我们去吃晚饭。

ex.en: High housing costs, coupled with limited childcare, can discourage young couples from starting a family.
ex.zh: 高昂的住房成本加上有限的托育服务，可能使年轻夫妇不愿生育孩子。

col: a married couple｜一对已婚夫妇
tip: a couple of后接复数名词，可指两个或少数几个。

senses.en: Feeling afraid of something or worried that something bad might happen.

ex.en: The puppy looked scared when it heard the thunder.
ex.zh: 小狗听到雷声时显得很害怕。

ex.en: Students who are scared of making mistakes may avoid speaking during foreign language lessons.
ex.zh: 害怕犯错的学生可能会在外语课上避免开口。

tip: scared形容感到害怕；scary形容令人害怕。

senses.en: below something else in position, level, or amount
to move something down or reduce its level

ex.en: Keep the heavy bowls on the lower shelf.
ex.zh: 把重碗放在下面那层架子上。

ex.en: Governments can lower transport costs by investing in reliable bus services and safe cycling routes.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资可靠的公交服务和安全的自行车道来降低交通成本。

tip: lower作动词通常接宾语；表示物价下降也可不及物。

senses.en: a small, flat piece of metal used as money
to invent a new word or expression

ex.en: A silver coin rolled under the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一枚银色硬币滚到了厨房桌子下面。

ex.en: As digital payments become more widespread, fewer consumers carry coins for everyday purchases such as bus fares.
ex.zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，随身携带硬币用于公交车费等日常支出的人越来越少。

tip: coin作动词常指创造词语，如coin a term。

senses.en: an ability to do something well, developed through practice

ex.en: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
ex.zh: 烤出好面包需要耐心和一点技巧。

ex.en: Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.
ex.zh: 学校应教授实用技能，帮助年轻人管理金钱并进行有效沟通。

col: develop a skill｜培养一项技能
skill in doing something｜做某事的技巧
tip: 具体技能可数；泛指熟练程度时常不可数。

senses.en: A lightweight frame flown in the wind on a string
A bird of prey with long wings and often a forked tail

ex.en: We flew a bright kite on the windy beach.
ex.zh: 我们在风大的海滩上放了一只色彩鲜艳的风筝。

ex.en: Outdoor activities such as flying kites offer families affordable recreation and encourage children to spend time away from screens.
ex.zh: 放风筝等户外活动为家庭提供了经济实惠的娱乐方式，也鼓励孩子暂时远离屏幕。

tip: “放风筝”用 fly a kite，不用 play a kite。

senses.en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem.
A particular thing that someone does.
Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.

ex.en: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
ex.zh: 我们得在漏水加重之前采取行动。

ex.en: Governments must take urgent action to protect coastal communities from the growing risks of climate change.
ex.zh: 政府必须紧急采取行动，保护沿海社区免受日益加剧的气候变化风险影响。

tip: take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。

senses.zh: 建造；建立（过去式及分词）
senses.en: past tense and past participle of build
having a particular body shape or physical build

ex.en: We built a small shelter for the garden tools.
ex.zh: 我们搭了一个小棚子，用来存放园艺工具。

ex.en: New homes should be built near public transport to reduce residents' dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 新住宅应建在公共交通设施附近，以减少居民对私家车的依赖。

col: well built｜体格健壮的；建造牢固的
tip: build的过去式、过去分词均为built，不是builded。

senses.en: to be determined or affected by something
to need or trust someone or something for support

ex.en: Our weekend plans depend on how the weather turns out.
ex.zh: 我们周末的安排取决于天气怎么样。

ex.en: Many rural communities depend on reliable public transport to access healthcare, education, and employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 许多农村社区依靠可靠的公共交通来获得医疗、教育和就业机会。

col: depend on someone to do something｜指望某人做某事
tip: 常接on或upon；It depends意为“看情况”。

senses.en: The middle of the day, around twelve o'clock.

ex.en: We stopped for lunch at mid-day beside the river.
ex.zh: 中午，我们在河边停下来吃午饭。

ex.en: Outdoor workers should have access to shade at mid-day, when exposure to direct sunlight can be intense.
ex.zh: 户外工作者在中午应有地方遮阴，因为此时阳光直射可能很强。

tip: 现代英语通常写midday；在正午用at midday。
note: 可用的连字符变体；现代通常拼作midday。

senses.en: to look carefully for something or someone
an attempt to find something

ex.en: We searched the whole house for the missing keys.
ex.zh: 我们把整座房子找遍了，寻找丢失的钥匙。

ex.en: Many students search the internet for information before writing their reports on climate change.
ex.zh: 许多学生在写气候变化报告前会上网搜索信息。

tip: search后接地点；search for后接寻找的对象。

senses.en: Something said or done to make people laugh.
To say something funny or not seriously meant.

ex.en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 我哥哥讲了个笑话，把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: Teachers sometimes use jokes to reduce anxiety and create a more relaxed classroom atmosphere.
ex.zh: 教师有时会用笑话缓解焦虑，营造更轻松的课堂氛围。

col: play a joke on someone｜捉弄某人
joke about something｜拿某事开玩笑
tip: 讲笑话用tell a joke，不用say a joke。

senses.en: Someone invited to visit a home or attend an event.
Someone staying at a hotel or similar accommodation.

ex.en: Each guest brought a dish to share at dinner.
ex.zh: 每位客人都带了一道菜，在晚餐时与大家分享。

ex.en: Hotels can encourage guests to conserve water by offering towel replacement only when requested.
ex.zh: 酒店可以仅在住客提出要求时更换毛巾，以鼓励节水。

tip: guest可指受邀客人，也可指付费的酒店住客。

senses.en: A surface on which electronic images or films appear.
To check people or things for problems or suitability.
To show a film or programme to an audience.

ex.en: I wiped the fingerprints off my laptop screen.
ex.zh: 我擦掉了笔记本电脑屏幕上的指纹。

ex.en: Health services should screen vulnerable patients regularly to detect diseases before serious symptoms develop.
ex.zh: 医疗服务机构应定期对易患病患者进行筛查，在严重症状出现前发现疾病。

tip: screen A for B表示检查A是否存在B问题。

senses.en: a machine that washes dishes and kitchen utensils
a person employed to wash dishes

ex.en: Please load the dishwasher after you finish your lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭吃完后，请把餐具放进洗碗机。

ex.en: Running a dishwasher only when it is full can help households conserve water and energy.
ex.zh: 等洗碗机装满后再运行，有助于家庭节约水和能源。

col: load the dishwasher｜把餐具装进洗碗机
unload the dishwasher｜取出洗碗机里的餐具
dishwasher detergent｜洗碗机专用洗涤剂
tip: 日常多指洗碗机；招聘语境中也可指洗碗工。

senses.en: In every way or to the fullest possible degree.

ex.en: My shoes were completely wet after walking through the rain.
ex.zh: 在雨中走过之后，我的鞋全湿透了。

ex.en: Although online courses offer flexibility, they cannot completely replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
ex.zh: 虽然在线课程提供了灵活性，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。

tip: 表示程度达到全部，常修饰形容词或动词。

senses.en: Someone you work, play, or share a business with.
Someone you share a romantic relationship or married life with.
Work or take part in an activity with someone.

ex.en: My dance partner waited patiently while I practised.
ex.zh: 我练习时，我的舞伴耐心地等着。

ex.en: Universities can partner with local businesses to offer students practical experience before they enter the workforce.
ex.zh: 大学可以与当地企业合作，让学生在就业前获得实践经验。

tip: partner不表明性别；作动词常用partner with。

senses.en: a pair of thin sticks used for eating food

ex.en: Can you pass me the chopsticks, please?
ex.zh: 请把筷子递给我好吗？

ex.en: Many students bring their own chopsticks to school to reduce plastic waste at lunch.
ex.zh: 许多学生自带筷子到学校，以减少午餐时的塑料浪费。

col: a pair of chopsticks｜一双筷子
tip: 复数形式常指“一双筷子”，谓语动词用复数。

senses.en: A sport involving hitting a shuttlecock over a net with rackets

ex.en: We play badminton at the sports centre every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们每周六都在体育中心打羽毛球。

ex.en: Schools can encourage regular exercise by offering accessible activities such as badminton and swimming.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供羽毛球和游泳等易于参与的活动来鼓励学生经常锻炼。

tip: 运动名通常不可数；“打羽毛球”用play badminton。

senses.en: not a single person
a person considered unimportant or unknown

ex.en: Nobody noticed the kitten sleeping behind the sofa.
ex.zh: 没人注意到睡在沙发后面的小猫。

ex.en: Nobody should be denied access to education because their family cannot afford school fees.
ex.zh: 任何人都不应因家庭付不起学费而被剥夺受教育的机会。

tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；本身含否定意义。

senses.en: the land along the edge of the sea
to move without using power or much effort
to succeed or progress without trying very hard

ex.en: We walked along the coast and collected smooth stones.
ex.zh: 我们沿着海岸散步，捡了一些光滑的石头。

ex.en: Communities along the coast face increasing risks from rising sea levels and severe storms.
ex.zh: 沿海社区面临着海平面上升和强风暴带来的日益严重的风险。

tip: on the coast指在海边；off the coast指在近海。

senses.en: To go or come into a place.
To become involved in a competition, activity, or organisation.
To put information into a computer or official record.

ex.en: Please wipe your shoes before you enter the kitchen.
ex.zh: 进入厨房前，请把鞋底擦干净。

ex.en: Young people often need practical training before they enter the workforce and take on professional responsibilities.
ex.zh: 年轻人在进入职场、承担职业责任之前，往往需要接受实践培训。

tip: 进入某地用enter a place，不加into。

senses.en: A large fortified building with thick walls and towers.

ex.en: We climbed the hill to explore the old castle.
ex.zh: 我们爬上山丘，去探索那座古堡。

ex.en: Restoring a historic castle can attract tourists while preserving valuable evidence of a region's architectural heritage.
ex.zh: 修复历史城堡既能吸引游客，也能保留体现当地建筑遗产的珍贵实物。

tip: castle中的t不发音；palace指宫殿。

senses.en: Extremely bad or unpleasant.

ex.en: The soup tasted awful, so I made a sandwich.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，所以我做了个三明治。

ex.en: Residents described the awful conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter safety standards.
ex.zh: 居民描述了过度拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁制定更严格的安全标准。

tip: feel awful可指身体难受，也可指内疚或心情差。

senses.en: Written words, especially the main written content of something.
A short written message sent using a phone.
Send someone a short written message using a phone.

ex.en: The text on this menu is too small.
ex.zh: 这份菜单上的字太小了。

ex.en: Teachers can combine text with images to help students understand complex scientific concepts more easily.
ex.zh: 教师可以将文字与图像结合，帮助学生更轻松地理解复杂的科学概念。

tip: 文字内容通常不可数；一条短信可说a text。

senses.en: something that happens because of an action or event
the final score or outcome of a test or competition
to happen because of something or cause something to happen

ex.en: The shiny floor was the result of hours of cleaning.
ex.zh: 这光亮的地板是花了好几个小时打扫的成果。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can result in lower emissions and shorter commuting times for urban residents.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通，可以减少排放并缩短城市居民的通勤时间。

tip: result in后接结果；result from后接原因。

senses.en: A large container that you sit in to wash your body.

ex.en: The kitten watched water dripping into the empty bathtub.
ex.zh: 小猫看着水滴进空浴缸。

ex.en: Replacing a bathtub with a shower can save space in small urban apartments.
ex.zh: 在小型城市公寓中，用淋浴设施替换浴缸可以节省空间。

tip: bathtub尤常用于美式英语；英式常说bath。

senses.en: A box where letters are delivered or collected.
An electronic space where email messages are received and stored.

ex.en: A postcard from my cousin arrived in our mailbox.
ex.zh: 表亲寄来的一张明信片到了我们家的信箱里。

ex.en: Residents in remote areas may travel considerable distances to reach the nearest public mailbox.
ex.zh: 偏远地区的居民可能需要走很远才能到达最近的公共邮筒。

tip: 美式常用词；英式常用letterbox或postbox。

senses.en: something you do regularly, often without thinking

ex.en: Checking my phone before breakfast has become a habit.
ex.zh: 早餐前查看手机已经成了我的习惯。

ex.en: Developing the habit of regular exercise during childhood can improve health throughout adult life.
ex.zh: 在童年时期养成规律锻炼的习惯，可以改善整个成年阶段的健康状况。

col: get into the habit of｜养成……的习惯
tip: 表示做某事的习惯，用habit of doing。

senses.en: The hard natural material forming much of Earth's surface.
Popular music with a strong beat, often featuring electric guitars.
Move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

ex.en: We sat on a flat rock beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们坐在河边一块平坦的岩石上。

ex.en: Studying ancient rock layers helps scientists understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
ex.zh: 研究古老的岩层有助于科学家了解地球气候随时间发生的变化。

tip: rock 作岩石材料不可数；指一块石头时可数。

senses.en: the activity of controlling a car or another road vehicle
strongly influencing something and making it happen
blown hard by strong winds

ex.en: Her careful driving made the mountain journey feel safe.
ex.zh: 她开车很谨慎，让这段山路旅程令人安心。

ex.en: Technological innovation is a driving force behind economic growth, although its benefits are not always shared equally.
ex.zh: 技术创新是经济增长的推动力，但其收益并不总能得到公平分享。

tip: driving force意为推动力；driving也可作drive的现在分词。

senses.en: A set of keys used to enter information into a computer

senses.zh: 乐器键盘；电子键盘乐器
senses.en: A musical instrument's keys, or an electronic instrument with keys

ex.en: I brushed the crumbs off my keyboard before starting work.
ex.zh: 开始工作前，我把键盘上的碎屑刷掉了。

ex.en: Students with limited mobility may benefit from an adapted keyboard that makes digital learning more accessible.
ex.zh: 行动不便的学生可能受益于经过改装的键盘，从而更方便地参与数字化学习。

col: play the keyboard｜弹电子键盘乐器
tip: 电脑键盘常说a keyboard；演奏键盘乐器用play the keyboard。

senses.en: a sliding storage compartment in a desk or other furniture

ex.en: I keep spare keys in the top kitchen drawer.
ex.zh: 我把备用钥匙放在厨房最上面的抽屉里。

ex.en: Office desks with lockable drawers help employees store personal belongings securely in shared working environments.
ex.zh: 配有可上锁抽屉的办公桌有助于员工在共享办公环境中安全存放私人物品。

tip: 抽屉是drawer；衣橱是wardrobe。

senses.en: an elastic material used to make tyres and other products
a small object used to remove pencil marks

ex.en: These rubber boots keep my feet dry in puddles.
ex.zh: 这双橡胶靴让我踩水坑时双脚也不会湿。

ex.en: Recycling rubber from used tyres can reduce waste and provide material for safer playground surfaces.
ex.zh: 回收废旧轮胎中的橡胶可以减少废物，并为更安全的游乐场地面提供材料。

tip: 橡胶不可数；橡皮擦可数，美式英语通常用eraser。

senses.en: To combine different substances or things.
A combination of different substances, people, or things.
To spend time socially with other people.

ex.en: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
ex.zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋放进大碗里拌匀。

ex.en: Successful neighbourhoods often contain a mix of housing types that serve people with different incomes.
ex.zh: 成功的社区通常包含多种住房类型，以满足不同收入人群的需求。

col: a diverse mix｜多样化的组合
tip: mix A with B指混合；mix A up with B指混淆。

senses.en: Energy carried by charged particles, used to power devices

ex.en: The storm cut off electricity to our entire street.
ex.zh: 暴风雨导致我们整条街停电了。

ex.en: Generating electricity from renewable sources can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
ex.zh: 利用可再生能源发电可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低温室气体排放。

tip: electricity不可数；electric多指用电的，electrical指电相关的。

senses.en: something made or grown to be sold or used
something that results from a process or situation
the result of multiplying two or more quantities

ex.en: This cleaning product removes stains from my kitchen tiles.
ex.zh: 这款清洁产品能去除我家厨房瓷砖上的污渍。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly prefer products that use less packaging and can be repaired rather than replaced.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越偏好包装更少、能够维修而不必更换的产品。

tip: product是产品或结果，production是生产过程。

senses.en: an African wild animal with black and white stripes

ex.en: A zebra stood quietly beside the watering hole.
ex.zh: 一匹斑马静静地站在水塘旁。

ex.en: Protecting grasslands helps zebra populations survive while preserving habitats for many other wild animals.
ex.zh: 保护草原有助于斑马种群生存，同时也为许多其他野生动物保留栖息地。

col: a herd of zebras｜一群斑马
tip: zebra crossing 是英式英语中的斑马线。

senses.en: a liquid product used to wash hair
to wash hair using shampoo

ex.en: I packed a small bottle of shampoo for our trip.
ex.zh: 我为这次旅行装了一小瓶洗发水。

ex.en: Using refillable shampoo containers can reduce plastic waste generated by households and the tourism industry.
ex.zh: 使用可补充装的洗发水容器可以减少家庭和旅游业产生的塑料垃圾。

col: a bottle of shampoo｜一瓶洗发水
shampoo your hair｜用洗发水洗头
tip: 泛指洗发水通常不可数；一瓶用a bottle of shampoo。

senses.en: A room or building equipped for scientific experiments and tests

ex.en: We wore safety goggles while mixing liquids in the lab.
ex.zh: 我们在实验室混合液体时戴着护目镜。

ex.en: A well-equipped school lab allows students to test scientific ideas through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
ex.zh: 设备齐全的学校实验室让学生通过实际实验检验科学观点，而非仅仅死记硬背。

tip: lab是laboratory的常用缩写，二者均为可数名词。

senses.en: Feeling that something unexpected has happened.

ex.en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
ex.zh: 发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。

ex.en: Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
ex.zh: 绿地的可及性对居民自报幸福感的影响如此之大，令研究人员感到惊讶。

col: surprised at the result｜对结果感到惊讶
surprised to hear｜听到后感到意外
tip: surprised形容人的感受；surprising形容事物令人惊讶。

senses.en: a device that heats air, water, or another substance

ex.en: We switched on the heater before the guests arrived.
ex.zh: 客人到来前，我们打开了取暖器。

ex.en: Replacing an inefficient water heater can lower household energy bills and reduce overall electricity consumption.
ex.zh: 更换效率低下的热水器能降低家庭能源账单，并减少总体用电量。

tip: heater是设备；heating指供暖或供暖系统。

senses.en: Someone qualified to advise people about law and represent them.

ex.en: Our lawyer explained the contract before we signed it.
ex.zh: 我们的律师在我们签字前解释了合同内容。

ex.en: Access to an affordable lawyer helps ensure that everyone can defend their legal rights.
ex.zh: 能以可负担的费用聘请律师，有助于确保每个人都能维护自己的合法权利。

tip: lawyer是律师的统称，区别于法官judge。

senses.en: a place where people buy goods
to keep something somewhere for future use
a supply of something kept for future use

ex.en: The store near our house sells fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的商店卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Modern batteries can store energy from solar panels for use when sunlight is no longer available.
ex.zh: 现代电池可以储存太阳能板产生的能量，以便在没有阳光时使用。

col: a store of knowledge｜知识储备
tip: 商店在美式中常用store，英式日常更常用shop。

senses.en: A round object that turns to move a vehicle.
The circular control used to steer a vehicle.
To move something along on its wheels.

ex.en: The front wheel of my bicycle needs replacing.
ex.zh: 我的自行车前轮需要更换。

ex.en: Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.
ex.zh: 交通规划者应确保乘客能轻松推着行李穿过车站并登上列车。

tip: at或behind the wheel常表示正在开车。

senses.en: A single object, especially one in a collection.
One part of a list, programme, or news report.

ex.en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
ex.zh: 请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。

ex.en: Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.
ex.zh: 会议议程中的每一项都涉及当地公共交通服务面临的不同挑战。

tip: item是可数名词；一件衣物可说an item of clothing。

senses.en: Someone who welcomes visitors and handles enquiries at a reception desk.

ex.en: The receptionist smiled and handed us our room keys.
ex.zh: 接待员微笑着把房间钥匙递给了我们。

ex.en: A skilled receptionist can improve patients' experiences by managing appointments efficiently and responding calmly to enquiries.
ex.zh: 熟练的接待员能够高效安排预约、沉着回应咨询，从而改善患者的就诊体验。

col: work as a receptionist｜担任接待员
tip: reception 是接待处；receptionist 是接待员。

senses.en: A man whose job is to sell goods or services.

ex.en: The salesman showed us how to fold the bicycle.
ex.zh: 那位男销售员向我们演示了如何折叠自行车。

ex.en: A skilled salesman should explain product limitations honestly rather than pressure customers into making unnecessary purchases.
ex.zh: 有技巧的销售员应如实解释产品的局限，而不是强迫顾客购买不必要的东西。

col: an experienced salesman｜经验丰富的销售员
tip: salesman明确指男性；不强调性别时用salesperson。

senses.en: extremely good or enjoyable
strange and imaginative, rather than realistic
extremely large in amount or degree

ex.en: We had a fantastic view of the mountains from our balcony.
ex.zh: 从阳台望去，山景美极了。

ex.en: Community sports programmes offer young people a fantastic opportunity to develop teamwork skills and build confidence.
ex.zh: 社区体育项目为年轻人提供了培养团队合作技能和增强自信的绝佳机会。

tip: 表示“极好的”偏口语；正式写作可用excellent。

senses.en: the activity or sport of moving quickly on foot
the work of managing or operating something
flowing continuously or operating rather than stopped

ex.en: Running along the beach always clears my head.
ex.zh: 沿着海滩跑步总能让我头脑清醒。

ex.en: Local volunteers play a crucial role in the daily running of community sports centres.
ex.zh: 当地志愿者在社区体育中心的日常管理中发挥着关键作用。

tip: 表示跑步活动时不可数；the running of指管理。

senses.en: A movable barrier controlling entry through a fence or wall.
An airport area where passengers board a plane.

ex.en: She closed the garden gate to keep the dog inside.
ex.zh: 她关上花园的门，免得狗跑出去。

ex.en: Airports should provide clear directions so passengers can reach their departure gate without unnecessary stress.
ex.zh: 机场应提供清晰的指引，让乘客无需过度紧张就能找到登机口。

tip: gate多指围墙或栅栏上的门；房间的门通常用door。

senses.en: the name given to a book, film, or other work
a name indicating someone's rank, position, or professional role
the position of winner in a sporting competition

ex.en: I remember the book's cover but not its title.
ex.zh: 我记得这本书的封面，却不记得书名了。

ex.en: An effective essay title should clearly indicate the main issue being discussed without revealing every detail.
ex.zh: 好的文章标题应清楚表明所讨论的主要问题，而不必透露所有细节。

tip: title是标题或名称；topic是讨论的主题。

senses.en: The area beside railway tracks where passengers board trains.
A raised surface where people can stand or perform.
A service or system for sharing information or doing activities.

ex.en: We waited on the platform as the train approached.
ex.zh: 火车驶近时，我们正在站台上等候。

ex.en: Online learning platforms allow students in remote areas to access courses that are unavailable locally.
ex.zh: 在线学习平台让偏远地区的学生能够学习当地没有开设的课程。

col: a platform for debate｜辩论的平台
tip: 在站台上用on the platform，不用in。

senses.en: The act of leaving a vehicle in a particular place.
Space or facilities where vehicles can be left.

ex.en: Parking is difficult on this narrow street after sunset.
ex.zh: 日落后，在这条狭窄的街道上停车很困难。

ex.en: Reducing free parking in city centres may encourage commuters to use public transport more frequently.
ex.zh: 减少市中心的免费停车位可能促使通勤者更频繁地使用公共交通。

tip: 名词通常不可数；一个停车位说a parking space。

senses.en: To take something's place or put something else in its place.
To put something back where it was before.

ex.en: We need to replace the broken kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我们需要换掉厨房里那把坏椅子。

ex.en: Renewable energy could gradually replace fossil fuels if governments invest sufficiently in infrastructure and storage technology.
ex.zh: 如果政府充分投资基础设施和储能技术，可再生能源就可能逐步取代化石燃料。

tip: replace A with B是用B换掉A，别弄反方向。

senses.en: An outdoor area beside a building, often enclosed.
A unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 metres.

ex.en: Our dog chased a yellow ball across the yard.
ex.zh: 我们的狗追着一个黄色的球跑过院子。

ex.en: Converting an unused school yard into a garden can provide valuable outdoor learning opportunities for urban children.
ex.zh: 把闲置的校园庭院改成花园，可以为城市儿童提供宝贵的户外学习机会。

col: a yard of fabric｜一码布料
tip: 美式yard可指住宅草坪庭院；英式多用garden。

senses.en: a machine that produces paper copies of digital documents or images
a person or business that prints books and other materials

ex.en: The printer ran out of paper halfway through my homework.
ex.zh: 我的作业打印到一半时，打印机没纸了。

ex.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by setting every printer to print on both sides automatically.
ex.zh: 学校可以将所有打印机设为自动双面打印，从而减少纸张浪费。

tip: print是打印；printer可指机器，也可指印刷从业者。

senses.en: Earth's solid surface, or an area used for a particular purpose.
To reach the ground, or bring an aircraft to the ground.
To succeed in getting something desirable, especially a job.

ex.en: After hours at sea, we finally spotted dry land.
ex.zh: 在海上航行数小时后，我们终于看到了陆地。

ex.en: Protecting agricultural land from urban expansion is essential for maintaining food production near growing cities.
ex.zh: 保护农业用地免受城市扩张侵占，对维持发展中城市周边的粮食生产至关重要。

col: land a job｜成功找到工作
tip: 表示土地通常不可数；land a job指成功获得工作。

senses.en: A man who works in business, especially managing a company.

ex.en: A local businessman opened a bakery near our school.
ex.zh: 一位当地商人在我们学校附近开了一家面包店。

ex.en: A successful businessman can support local development by investing in training and creating stable employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 成功的商人可以通过投资培训和创造稳定就业机会来支持当地发展。

tip: 复数为businessmen；不限定性别可用businessperson。

senses.en: Feeling happy or pleased about something.
Willing and pleased to do something.

ex.en: I'm glad you came to dinner with us tonight.
ex.zh: 我很高兴你今晚来和我们一起吃饭。

ex.en: Many residents were glad that the council had decided to preserve the local park.
ex.zh: 许多居民都很高兴，地方议会决定保留当地的公园。

tip: 常作表语；用be glad to do或be glad that从句。

senses.en: To give out or reflect light.
To polish something until its surface becomes bright and smooth.
Brightness on a smooth surface that reflects light.

ex.en: The sun shone through my bedroom window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，阳光透过我卧室的窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Streetlights that shine directly into homes can disturb sleep and reduce residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 直接照进住宅的路灯会干扰睡眠，降低居民的生活质量。

col: shine a light on｜用灯照向
tip: 发光的过去式常用shone；擦亮的过去式用shined。

senses.en: going far down from the top or surface
far down or into something
strong and serious (of feelings)

ex.en: The lake is very deep, so we must be careful.
ex.zh: 这个湖很深，所以我们必须小心。

ex.en: Reading good books can give you a deep understanding of human nature and society.
ex.zh: 读好书能让你对人性与社会有深刻的理解。

tip: deep 可作形容词和副词；注意 deeply 多用于抽象情感，如 deeply moved。

senses.en: A sweet, juicy fruit, often narrower at the top

ex.en: She sliced a ripe pear into her breakfast bowl.
ex.zh: 她把一个熟梨切成片，放进早餐碗里。

ex.en: Buying locally grown pears during their natural season may reduce the need for long-distance food transport.
ex.zh: 在自然成熟的季节购买本地种植的梨，可能减少长途食品运输的需求。

tip: pear与pair同音；一个梨用a pear。

senses.en: A day when you do not have to work.

ex.en: On my day off, I cycled to the lake.
ex.zh: 休息那天，我骑车去了湖边。

ex.en: Taking a regular day off allows employees to recover and may improve their performance at work.
ex.zh: 定期休息一天能让员工恢复精力，也可能提高工作表现。

col: take a day off｜休息一天
have a day off｜有一天休假
a day off work｜一天不上班
tip: 复数是days off；请一天假可说take a day off。

senses.en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh.
The humorous quality of a situation or event.

ex.en: We watched a comedy and laughed all evening.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部喜剧，整个晚上都笑个不停。

ex.en: Comedy can encourage audiences to question social attitudes by presenting familiar problems in unexpected and amusing ways.
ex.zh: 喜剧可以用出人意料又有趣的方式呈现常见问题，促使观众反思社会观念。

tip: 指喜剧类型时通常不可数；一部喜剧用a comedy。

senses.en: without waiting or any delay
directly before, after, or next to something
as soon as something happens

ex.en: When the doorbell rang, I immediately opened the door.
ex.zh: 门铃一响，我就立刻打开了门。

ex.en: Schools should respond immediately to safety concerns rather than waiting for a serious incident to occur.
ex.zh: 学校应立即回应安全方面的担忧，而不是等到严重事件发生才采取行动。

tip: 作连词表示“一……就”主要见于英式英语。

senses.en: an appliance or compartment that keeps food frozen

ex.en: Put the ice cream back in the freezer.
ex.zh: 把冰激凌放回冷冻室。

ex.en: Using a freezer allows households to store seasonal produce longer and reduce food waste.
ex.zh: 使用冷冻柜能让家庭更长时间地储存时令农产品，减少食物浪费。

col: defrost the freezer｜给冷冻柜除霜
tip: freezer用于冷冻；fridge主要用于冷藏。

senses.en: A bag carried on your back using shoulder straps.

ex.en: I packed my lunch and jacket in a rucksack.
ex.zh: 我把午餐和夹克装进了双肩背包。

ex.en: Travellers carrying only a rucksack can move more easily between public transport services.
ex.zh: 只背一个双肩包的旅行者换乘公共交通时行动更方便。

tip: 英式英语常用rucksack；不限定帆布材质。

senses.en: having a strong, unpleasant smell
(informal) unpleasant or bad

ex.en: My sports shoes are smelly after a long day of running.
ex.zh: 跑了一整天后，我的运动鞋很臭。

ex.en: The town built a new system to deal with smelly rubbish in summer.
ex.zh: 这座城镇建了新的系统来处理夏季发臭的垃圾。

col: a smelly mess｜又脏又臭的一团糟
tip: smelly 多含贬义，说东西难闻；描述香味用 sweet-smelling。
